summary: The fleet array; at least one vehicle is required. Each entry is a vehicle with capacity/skills/shift/anchors.
range: Array of vehicle objects; length >= 1. Each requires id.
businessRules: vehicles defines: The vehicles attribute describes the characteristics and constraints of the vehicles that will be used for fulfilling the tasks. Read more about this attribute in the [Vehicle Object](#vehicle-obje…
Each element in vehicles must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.capacity, vehicles.skills, vehicles.time_window. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
